title: 第11章 二十几岁的筑基后期第12章 击败葛颜
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
曹立微眯着眼看着他们大步的离开。
他在等，等他们几个到执法堂外面的空地，免得动起手来，把执法堂拆了，或者误伤费队和小虎等人。
转眼间，葛颜和几个内门弟子，就走出了执法堂。
葛颜嘴里还不忘嘲讽一句废物，其他几个内门弟子听到后，纷纷哈哈大笑，故意笑得很大声。
这种嘲讽，让执法堂内的各位成员，都握紧了拳头。
耻辱，奇耻大辱。
都被人打上门来了，还不敢动手，孬种吗？
唐长老六百多岁了，只想安享晚年，这可以理解，可是不至于连骨气都没了吧？
行刑司欧阳长老，想专心突破元婴，可这都被人打上门了，都不带露面的。
而执法队队长们，又青黄不接，没有一个上筑基境。
“曹立，葛颜可是亲传弟子，你何苦跟他过不去？”唐长老拉着曹立的手，好言相劝。
曹立一言不发，一双眼睛如同鹰眼，死死的盯着葛颜等人背后。
突然，曹立直接挣脱了唐长老的手，如脱手的兔子，一下子冲出执法堂：“今天你们能走，我就不姓曹。”
曹立大喝一声，走出执法堂后，手往天上一抛，一把戒尺脱手而出，之后从天而降，扎在葛颜他们前面五米开外。
唐长老错愕，曹立这发的什么疯？？
练气九层，要拦住几个筑基？莫不是以为自己会为他撑腰？
可对面就没撑腰的？
我一个老头子，实力在下滑，虽然结丹初期，可是比起年轻气盛的结丹境，可是打不过的，更别说站在葛颜身后的燕山主了，他最不想得罪的，就是燕山主。
虽然他们执法堂占理。
葛颜等人看到一把戒尺，插在他们面前，这种严重挑衅的行为，若是还能忍，他就不是亲传了。

亲传的代表词，就是无法无天，嚣张跋扈。
葛颜只觉得可笑，曹立，他凭什么呀？
葛颜回过头来：“曹立，你是真的不见棺材不掉泪啊！”
后面一个内门弟子是个暴脾气，也急于表现：“葛师兄，让我来教训他。”
葛颜不说话，就是默认。
看向曹立的眼睛，那就是挑衅，似乎在说，你看，我一个小弟，都能把你收拾得服服帖帖的，你拿什么跟我斗？
“袭击执法堂长老，罪加一等，这可是死罪。”曹立站在那里大喊。
“哈哈哈。”葛颜等人齐齐大笑。
“长老，我笑了，你觉得宗门律令，对我有用吗？哈哈哈！”葛颜大笑。
其他的内门弟子也大笑，太搞笑了。
“只要是凌阳宗内的人，宗门律令就有用，你们敢动手试试看。”曹立大喝一声。
那内门弟子有点犹豫，毕竟他们身后是没有山主撑腰的，所以看向了葛颜。
葛颜点头，那内门弟子，立马有了底气：“那我今天就拿你这个长老来试试。”
说完，双手掐诀，天地灵气被调动，凝聚成了一把一把的灵气之剑，朝曹立冲过去。
这种没有实体的剑，杀伤力不会很大，但也只是相对于筑基境来说，对付练气九层，就是绝杀。
如果唐长老不阻止，曹立必死无疑。
曹立大喝：“胆敢袭击执法堂长老，死！”
曹立的死字，咬得气势十足。
说罢，一只手朝天上伸去，手掌一握。
那边唐长老正准备出手，突然眼睛一瞪，咦了一声。

而葛颜等人，只觉得周遭的天气灵气，也被调动起来了。
content_en:
Cao Li narrowed his eyes slightly and watched them strode away.
He was waiting for them to reach the open space outside the law enforcement hall, so as not to take action and demolish the law enforcement hall, or accidentally injure Fei Dui, Xiaohu and others.
In the blink of an eye, Ge Yan and several inner disciples walked out of the law enforcement hall.
Ge Yan did not forget to ridicule "trash" in his mouth. After hearing this, several other inner disciples burst into laughter, deliberately laughing loudly.
This kind of ridicule made every member of the Law Enforcement Hall clenched their fists.
Shame, shame and humiliation.
You've been beaten at your door and you still don't dare to take action. Are you a coward?
Elder Tang is over 600 years old, and he just wants to enjoy his old age. This is understandable, but it doesn't mean that he has lost his backbone, right?
Elder Ouyang of the Execution Department wanted to concentrate on breaking through the Nascent Soul, but people were knocking on him all the time without even showing up.
As for the captains of the law enforcement team, they were inactive, and none of them reached the foundation-building realm.
"Cao Li, Ge Yan is his direct disciple, why are you trying to get in trouble with him?" Elder Tang took Cao Li's hand and tried to persuade him.
Cao Li said nothing, his eyes like eagle eyes, staring at the backs of Ge Yan and others.
Suddenly, Cao Li broke free from Elder Tang's hand, and rushed out of the law enforcement hall like a rabbit out of hand: "If you can leave today, my surname is not Cao."
Cao Li shouted loudly, walked out of the law enforcement hall, threw his hand into the sky, and a ruler came out of his hand, then fell from the sky and stuck five meters in front of Ge Yan and the others.
Elder Tang was stunned, why is Cao Li so crazy? ?
At the ninth level of Qi training, how many foundations should be blocked? Could it be that you thought you would support him?
But there’s no support from the other side?
I am an old man, but my strength is declining. Although I am in the early stage of forming a pill, I can't beat the young and energetic one in the realm of forming a pill, let alone Lord Yanshan who is standing behind Ge Yan. The person he least wants to offend is Lord Yanshan.
Although they enforce the law.
Ge Yan and others saw a ruler thrust in front of them. If they could tolerate such a serious provocation, he would not be the one who inherited it.
The personal representative words are lawlessness, arrogance and domineering.
Ge Yan only thought it was ridiculous, Cao Li, why should he?
Ge Yan turned around and said, "Cao Li, you really won't shed tears until you see the coffin!"
The inner disciple behind him had a bad temper and was eager to show off: "Senior Brother Ge, let me teach him a lesson."
Ge Yan didn't speak, it was acquiescence.
Looking into Cao Li's eyes, it was provocation, as if to say, look, I, a younger brother, can keep you in submission, so why are you fighting with me?
"Assaulting the elders of the Law Enforcement Hall will be punished with an additional penalty. This is a death penalty." Cao Li stood there and shouted.
"Hahaha." Ge Yan and others laughed together.
"Elder, I laughed. Do you think the sect's laws are useful to me? Hahaha!" Ge Yan laughed.
The other inner disciples also laughed, it was so funny.
"As long as you are a member of the Lingyang Sect, the sect's laws are effective. You dare to give it a try." Cao Li shouted.
The inner disciple was a little hesitant. After all, they did not have the support of the mountain master behind them, so they looked at Ge Yan.
Ge Yan nodded, and the inner disciple immediately felt confident: "Then I will try it on you, the elder, today."
After saying that, he made a hand seal with his hands, and the spiritual energy of heaven and earth was mobilized, condensed into swords of spiritual energy, and rushed towards Cao Li.
This kind of disembodied sword will not be very lethal, but it is only relative to the foundation building level. It is a sure kill against the ninth level of Qi training.
If Elder Tang doesn't stop it, Cao Li will definitely die.
Cao Li shouted: "If you dare to attack the elders of the Law Enforcement Hall, you will die!"
Cao Li said the word "death" with full force.
After saying that, he stretched out his hand toward the sky and grasped it with his palm.
Over there, Elder Tang was about to take action, when suddenly his eyes widened and he let out a sigh.
Ge Yan and others felt that the aura of the weather around them had also been mobilized.
